conf.description: cisco-asa acl-deny dataset, netflow (NSEL flow-denied) format: binary NetFlow v9 decoded upstream (NetFlow collector or Elastic Agent netflow input), with ECS mapping owned by the Elastic NetFlow Records integration and its @custom pipeline (NF_F_FW_EVENT=3, NF_F_FW_EXT_EVENT lookup, ACL-id hashes). This pipeline is intentionally thin: it only tags event.dataset and passes the decoded record through untouched.

conf.comment: cisco-asa / acl-deny / netflow: NSEL flow-denied records. Same decoder story as connection-events -- Cribl Stream cannot decode binary NetFlow v9, and the map documents its field table using generic vendor mnemonics (NF_F_FW_EVENT, NF_F_INGRESS_ACL_ID, ...) rather than the literal JSON key names an upstream decoder emits, so no rename is attempted here to avoid guessing key names. All ECS mapping is left to the Elastic netflow integration.
